breakNotes.Fall Break: Students and staff have the full week off. Plano ISD’s Board Briefs say principals requested this change during the calendar review process. Classes resume Monday, October 18.
breakNotes.Thanksgiving Break: Students have no classes all five weekdays. The text-format calendar labels November 22–26 as Thanksgiving Break, while the graphic calendar also identifies November 22–23 as Professional Learning Trade Days.

whatsNew.title: What’s Different About the 2027–28 Calendar
content: The first day stays on August 11. Students start Wednesday, August 11, 2027, compared with Tuesday, August 11 in 2026–27.
The school year ends later in May. The last day moves from May 21 in 2026–27 to May 24 in 2027–28.
Fall Break is now a full staff-and-student holiday week. October 11–15 is a full week off for both groups, and Plano ISD said principals requested the change during calendar review.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Plano ISD start school in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of classes is Wednesday, August 11, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Plano ISD in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of classes is Wednesday, May 24, 2028. It is also a student early-release day.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Plano ISD Fall Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Monday, October 11, through Friday, October 15, 2027. Students and staff have the full week off, and classes resume Monday, October 18.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Plano ISD Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 13, through Friday, March 17, 2028. March 20 is a separate student holiday and staff work day; classes resume Tuesday, March 21.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Plano ISD Winter Break in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Plano ISD officially lists Winter Break from Monday, December 20, through Friday, December 31, 2027. January 3–4 are separate student holidays and staff work days.

calendarFaqs.q: When do Plano ISD students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Classes resume Wednesday, January 5, 2028, which is also the start of the second semester.

calendarFaqs.q: Is May 24, 2028 an early-release day in Plano ISD?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Wednesday, May 24 is both the last day of classes and a student early-release day.

customSections.label: Calendar Details That Are Easy to Miss
customSections.content: Plano ISD publishes both a graphic calendar and a text-format academic calendar. The two calendars agree on student attendance dates, but staff labels differ on several no-school dates. The notes below explain the student-facing schedule and flag those differences where relevant.

definitions.description: Official Winter Break runs December 20–31. Students remain off January 3–4, but Plano ISD lists those dates separately as student holidays and staff work days. Classes resume January 5.
Both are student early-release days. December 17 closes the first semester, and May 24 is the last day of classes.
Students have no classes all five weekdays. The text-format calendar calls the full period Thanksgiving Break; the graphic calendar also labels November 22–23 as Professional Learning Trade Days.
Plano ISD officially labels both dates as student and staff holidays. Together with the weekend, they create four consecutive days without classes.

customSections.label: Early Release, Semesters, and Grading Periods
customSections.content: Plano ISD’s published calendars provide semester and grading-period details. The text-format calendar also lists early-release dismissal times.

definitions.description: December 17 and May 24 are student early-release days. December 17 is the last day of the first semester; May 24 is the last day of classes.
The first semester has 80 instructional days and the second has 91, for 171 total instructional days.

The four periods are August 11–October 8 (41 days), October 18–December 17 (39 days), January 5–March 10 (46 days), and March 21–May 23 (45 days). The district separately lists May 24 as the student early-release and last day of school.

The text-format calendar lists 1:10 p.m. for high and senior high schools, 1:30 p.m. for Academy High School, and 12:40 p.m. for middle schools on the last exam day only. Elementary early release is noon; early childhood early release is 11:55 a.m.
